newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BETIS STRIKER PEREZ SUSPENDED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BETIS STRIKER PEREZ SUSPENDED.

text.p: Real Betis striker Alfonso Perez will miss Saturday's vital league game against Spanish leaders Real Madrid after losing an appeal against a one-match suspension on Tuesday.

Perez, who is a regular in the Spanish side and Betis' leading scorer this season, received an automatic suspension after receiving his fifth yellow card of the season last weekend for a handball offence in Betis' 3-1 win over Extremadura.
Either Juan Sabas or Polish forward Wojciech are expected to replace Perez.

Less surprising was the decision to uphold the suspension of Real Madrid defender Carlos Secretario, who was an unlikely starter for the Betis game because of the return of former AC Milan man Christian Panucci from international duty.
The Spanish Federation disciplinary committee also ordered the closure of Zaragoza's Romareda stadium following an incident in which a linesman was hit by an object thrown from the stands.
